messages.subject: gvisLineChart troubles
parts:
Cannot understand why I can render a table with gvisTable after pulling stocks prices from Yahoo but cannot render a line chart with gvisLineChart.  THANKS IN ADVANCE - BEEN ROUND AND ROUND ON THIS FOR 2 DAYS

This works
output$plot1 = renderGvis({gvisTable(as.data.frame(getSymbols(input$symb, src = "yahoo", from = input$dates[1], to = input$dates[2], auto.assign = FALSE)[,6]))})

But this does not
output$plot1 = renderGvis({gvisLineChart(as.data.frame(getSymbols(input$symb, src = "yahoo", from = input$dates[1], to = input$dates[2], auto.assign = FALSE)[,6]))})

Produces error "Error in `[.data.frame`(data, , c(xvar, yvar)) :
  undefined columns selected"

I suppose the table doesn't depend on rownames as the time element as perhaps the gvisLineChart is expecting.  But I don't know how to set xvar in gvisLineChart to rownames without explicitly setting a new column names something like date and making sure it is as.Date.  But trying to manipulate the data as a data.frame before rendering the line chart I always run into the Error: 'cannot coerce class ""reactive"" to a data.frame'
